title: Turning health 0 into a knockout needs the Dead state off on the server and the owning client
observation: To replace death and respawn with a 5 second knockout, the humanoid's Dead state was switched off (SetStateEnabled(Dead, false)) on the server and also on the player's own client, which runs its own humanoid's state machine; with both, health 0 no longer killed the character and a HealthChanged handler started the knockout. Roblox's default health regeneration then raised a downed character's health above 0, so the handler held it at 0 until the knockout ended. A body that fell out of the world or lost its root still needed a real respawn (LoadCharacter), checked a couple of times a second.
recommendation: When death should become something else, disable the Dead state on both the server and the owning client before health can reach 0, hold health at 0 for the duration against regeneration, mark the state with an attribute other systems check, and keep a fallback respawn for bodies that leave the world.
applies_when: Replacing Roblox death and respawn with a downed, knocked-out or revive state
limits: One Studio client; Roblox's Reset button was routed to a real respawn but not pressed in testing

evidence.detail: The knockout in detail: drained to 0, knocked out in place, treasure dropped, up after 5 s with full health, no respawn.
